opinions: ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD INDEED PRIORITIZE HUMAN WELFARE, ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY, AND BROAD-BASED PROSPERITY OVER THE NARROW INTERESTS OF TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
I REJECT BLIND NATIONALISM; SUPPORTING ONE'S COUNTRY WHEN IT IS WRONG IS MORALLY INDEFENSIBLE.
PRIDE IN ONE'S COUNTRY OF BIRTH IS LARGELY IRRATIONAL SINCE NO ONE CHOOSES WHERE THEY ARE BORN.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR INHERENT QUALITIES; ALL SUCH CLAIMS ARE PSEUDOSCIENTIFIC AND DANGEROUS.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL CONSISTENCY AND VALUES MATTER MORE THAN TACTICAL CONVENIENCE.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS ALMOST NEVER JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS DEGRADED PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND MADE SOCIETY MORE SUSCEPTIBLE TO MISINFORMATION.
CLASS DIVISIONS REMAIN AMONG THE MOST POWERFUL AND UNDERAPPRECIATED SOURCES OF SOCIAL AND POLITICAL CONFLICT.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN CONTROLLING INFLATION WHEN THE TWO CONFLICT.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE STRICT REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE PROFIT MOTIVES ALONE CANNOT BE TRUSTED TO DO SO.
THE PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' REFLECTS A NOBLE IDEAL, THOUGH ITS IMPLEMENTATION HAS OFTEN FAILED.
MARKETS CAN ENHANCE FREEDOM IN MANY DOMAINS, BUT THE IDEA THAT FREER MARKETS AUTOMATICALLY MEAN FREER PEOPLE IS SIMPLISTIC AND OFTEN FALSE.
IT IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS ESSENTIAL AS WATER HAS BECOME A HEAVILY MARKETED BRANDED PRODUCT.
TREATING LAND PURELY AS A COMMODITY TO BE BOUGHT AND SOLD HAS LED TO SERIOUS SOCIAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS.
IT IS REGRETTABLE WHEN VAST FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH FINANCIAL MANIPULATION THAT CREATES NO REAL SOCIETAL VALUE.
STRATEGIC PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT VITAL INDUSTRIES AND WORKERS FROM DESTRUCTIVE TRADE PRACTICES.
A COMPANY'S SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY EXTENDS FAR BEYOND MAXIMIZING SHAREHOLDER PROFIT; IT INCLUDES ETHICAL TREATMENT OF WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED; MANY WEALTHY INDIVIDUALS AND CORPORATIONS PAY DISPROPORTIONATELY LOW EFFECTIVE TAX RATES.
ALLOWING SUPERIOR MEDICAL CARE BASED PURELY ON ABILITY TO PAY DEEPENS UNJUST INEQUALITIES IN LIFE EXPECTANCY AND QUALITY OF LIFE.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC, AS THIS CONSTITUTES FRAUD WITH REAL SOCIETAL HARM.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE ACTIVE RESTRICTIONS ON MONOPOLIES AND PREDATORY CORPORATE BEHAVIOR.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL; THE DECISION BELONGS TO THE PREGNANT WOMAN, NOT THE STATE, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE OPEN TO QUESTIONING AND SCRUTINY; THIS IS FUNDAMENTAL TO A HEALTHY SOCIETY.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE EXPRESSED AS 'AN EYE FOR AN EYE' IS PRIMITIVE AND USUALLY COUNTERPRODUCTIVE.
SOCIETIES BENEFIT FROM SUPPORTING ARTS AND CULTURE THROUGH PUBLIC FUNDING; THEATERS AND MUSEUMS SHOULD NOT BE JUDGED SOLELY BY COMMERCIAL VIABILITY.
SCHOOL ATTENDANCE SHOULD REMAIN COMPULSORY; EDUCATION IS A PUBLIC GOOD THAT REQUIRES STRUCTURE FOR MOST CHILDREN.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, THE IDEA THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD 'KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND' PROMOTES HARMFUL SEGREGATION.
PHYSICAL PUNISHMENT OF CHILDREN IS UNNECESSARY AND OFTEN HARMFUL; BETTER FORMS OF DISCIPLINE EXIST.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO MAINTAIN SOME PRIVACY AND SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY.
POSSESSING SMALL AMOUNTS OF MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENSE.
WHILE PREPARING STUDENTS FOR EMPLOYMENT IS IMPORTANT, THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CULTIVATE CRITICAL THINKING, CIVIC VIRTUE, AND WELL-ROUNDED HUMAN BEINGS.
FORCIBLY PREVENTING PEOPLE WITH INHERITABLE DISABILITIES FROM REPRODUCING IS A GROSS VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS.
WHILE DISCIPLINE MATTERS, THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS HOW TO THINK INDEPENDENTLY AND TREAT OTHERS WITH EMPATHY AND RESPECT.
THERE ARE NO INHERENTLY SAVAGE OR CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES WITH DIFFERENT VALUES AND PRACTICES.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE BUT REFUSE TO WORK SHOULD NOT EXPECT INDEFINITE SUPPORT FROM SOCIETY WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS GENERALLY BETTER TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS EMOTIONS THOUGHTFULLY RATHER THAN SIMPLY KEEP BUSY TO AVOID THEM.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND OFTEN DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED INTO THEIR NEW COUNTRY, THOUGH IT MAY TAKE TIME AND EFFORT ON BOTH SIDES.
WHAT IS GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS FREQUENTLY NOT GOOD FOR ORDINARY CITIZENS, WORKERS, OR THE ENVIRONMENT.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR INDEPENDENT BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE PUBLIC MEDIA CAN SERVE A VITAL DEMOCRATIC FUNCTION.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN MANY COUNTRIES IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, OFTEN WITH LITTLE DEMONSTRATED SECURITY BENEFIT.
THE SUPPOSED EFFICIENCY ADVANTAGE OF A ONE-PARTY STATE IS VASTLY OUTWEIGHED BY ITS TENDENCY TOWARD CORRUPTION, ABUSE OF POWER, AND SUPPRESSION OF TRUTH.
MASS SURVEILLANCE THREATENS EVERYONE, NOT JUST WRONGDOERS; IT CHILLS FREE EXPRESSION AND CREATES DANGEROUS POWER IMBALANCES.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS IMMORAL, IRREVERSIBLE, AND DISPROPORTIONATELY APPLIED; IT SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
A HEALTHY CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE RIGID HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOES NOT REPRESENT RECOGNIZABLE OBJECTS CAN STILL BE GENUINE AND VALUABLE ART.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY BE PRIORITIZED OVER PURE PUNISHMENT WHERE POSSIBLE.
IT IS RARELY A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION; MOST CRIMINALS ARE CAPABLE OF CHANGE UNDER THE RIGHT CONDITIONS.
WRITERS, ARTISTS, AND CREATIVE THINKERS CONTRIBUTE AT LEAST AS MUCH TO HUMAN FLOURISHING AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS CAN HAVE CAREERS; NEITHER HAS AN INHERENT 'FIRST DUTY' TO BE A HOMEMAKER THAT OVERRIDES PERSONAL CHOICE.
WE MUST TAKE THE WARNINGS OF CLIMATE SCIENCE SERIOUSLY AND MOVE BEYOND THE OBSESSION WITH PERPETUAL ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT IS NOT AN IMPORTANT ASPECT OF MATURITY; QUESTIONING UNJUST SYSTEMS OFTEN IS.
ASTROLOGY HAS NO SCIENTIFIC BASIS AND DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING MEANINGFUL.
ONE CAN BE HIGHLY MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS DO NOT REQUIRE SUPERNATURAL BELIEF.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR TO PRIVATE CHARITY AS A SYSTEMATIC, RELIABLE, AND DIGNITY-PRESERVING WAY TO HELP THE DISADVANTAGED.
LUCK EXISTS, BUT THE IDEA THAT SOME PEOPLE ARE 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY' OFTEN MASKS SYSTEMIC FACTORS AND PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY.
PUBLIC SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT INSTILL SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD REMAIN SECULAR.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL WHEN PRACTICED CONSENSUALLY AND RESPONSIBLY BETWEEN ADULTS.
STABLE, LOVING SAME-SEX COUPLES SHOULD BE FULLY ELIGIBLE TO ADOPT CHILDREN.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULT CONSUMPTION.
WHAT CONSENTING ADULTS DO IN PRIVATE IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
SEXUAL ORIENTATION HAS STRONG BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS; PEOPLE DO NOT CHOOSE TO BE HOMOSEXUAL.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; GREATER HONESTY AND REDUCED SHAME AROUND SEXUALITY HAVE BEEN LARGELY POSITIVE DEVELOPMENTS.
